I want to add that WKCR, Carlos de Leon, Jose Luis Morin and Cheo Diaz, play a lot of Machito records.

All right, those people, they know what they are playing, they like what they are playing. I don't like to somebody play my records because is in the program, because somebody forced them to play or for the administration say play Machito records. I like to listen to the music that the disk jockey wants to play. That made me enjoy more than if I know that's above the fifteen minutes, the twenty minutes or whatever, to listen to the music that I play or because the promoter, that's going to run the dance, in that…
